notes.title: First Major Update Adds So Many Things
notes.notes:
The first major update is coming on May the 25th, and it is packed with goodies. 

There are so many things to list. I don't want to tell you them all, I want everyone to discover them, but here are some things that I can bring up. 

There are new things to do and new rare events. You can get a job, have a drink or maybe do some dancing for money.

The store has been redesigned inside and there are many more food options available. Maybe you'll want to guzzle hot sauce without paying? You might go to jail for stealing, you might go crazy from hot sauce or both! Cool down the spice with some milk from the new freezers. Smash bottles like a champ and light some fires.

You can lay down on the bed to sleep through the night, or maybe do a night job and earn some extra money. Be careful, or you may see aliens or other dark creatures.

Going insane is now something that you have to deal with and there are a few things you can do to settle your mind and come back down to reality. Have a smoke to calm your nerves, or take some pills if you have the money. Don't take too much, or you might get addicted, and if you do you'll need to keep up that addiction.

There are many secrets to discover.

Still working on getting the Oculus system mapped out.

notes.title: New beer and more fixes
notes.notes:
Now there are three new types of beer in the fridge that can be pulled out and drank. Currently these spawn randomly when you grab a beer, so you won't know what you're getting. In the future they will be inside of the case and you'll be able to pull the one that you want and purchase it at the front counter.

If you haven't noticed, the bottles are all filled with liquid. Check it out.

The police behave a bit differently now and will only come out when you have done something wrong. Don't worry. It doesn't necessarily mean that they are going to arrest you if you see them out and about, but they are watching you, so be careful.

The microwave has had some fixes, but the door is still not in working order, so you'll have to place the food inside by grabbing the food and reaching inside to drop it. Try making a frozen burrito.

I have added some text before transitions between night and day, day and night, going to jail and death so that it's not quite a surprise when the change happens. There will be different and better transitions in the future, but these should make it a bit easier to understand what's going on.

There have been some additions to the corner store as well. There are now lights on the ceiling and speakers that will be playing music on a future update.

The trash has been fixed and now spawns correctly in the trash bin as well as from the trash bags. It also can now all be picked up and any paper items can be used to start a fire to keep you warm.

Along with all of this there have been several other fixes, improvements and additions to deal with some glitches and gameplay issues.

notes.title: First big update let's you put the toilet seat down
notes.notes:
[h1][b]This update comes with a lot of fixes and a couple new features.[/b][/h1]

-The criminal level was broken and people kept being sent back to jail. This has been fixed
-The amount of time spent in jail has been corrected
-Days and nights did not transition properly, and now they should
-Wine bottles now smash
-Wine bottles are now filled with liquid. Beer is next
-Pee was not showing. This has been fixed
-Vomit was not showing. This has been fixed
-Toilet seat flaps*
-There is a new microwave with better functionality
-Frozen burritos have been added
-New freezers have been added
-The sink water now should be working
-Basic transitions have been set in place
-Punching now is based on force
-Newspapers are in place and will begin showing regular news upon the next update
-Secrets

*The toilet seat in the corner shop bathroom can now be set in the up or down position. This is vitally important to the game and many sleepless nights were spent getting it just right. Now you can lift the seat, or lower the seat, depending on your desired preference. Finally, a piece of truly essential gameplay has been implemented for the masses. Use it wisely, hobos.

notes.title: Drinking, eating and other key issues fixed...like starting the game at all
notes.notes:
Today's update takes care of some major issues that came about because of the last update. 

The biggest fix is to the main menu. Some people were not able to even start the game. This has all been fixed and everyone should be able to get in by eating the hamburger.

There is now a floating sign that holds the notepad. You can either take the notepad and walk around with it, or leave it in the sign and check back from time to time. The notepad shows all your hobo stats.

The beer bottles were not pouring correctly, and now they do. Drink from them to take care of thirst.

The wine bottles disappear and can't be used. Keep with beer for now.

Hunger can be dealt with by eating hamburgers, frozen dinners and burritos, which currently look more like toasted bedroom toys than burritos. You can eat the food items cold, or warm them up by placing them in the microwave and get a bit more out of them. 

Food, cigarettes, beer and trash for the fire all spawn in the garbage can daily. Trash is also put out daily. Pick up a bag and then put it back down to access the trash inside. Put it in the barrel to start a fire and stay warm. Some pieces of garbage seem to lock the player down. This is being worked on.

When you turn on the sink the water is running and you can wash your hands. At the moment the water is not showing up, but if you move your hands back and forth under the faucet you will get clean.

The store now sort of works, but you don't really have to worry about money yet in the game. To shop, put food items into the wooden crate sitting on the chair inside, then place the crate on the scale next to the register. You can also tap the register to access a quick spawn menu.

The framerate has had another improvement and the game runs very smooth now. Movement has also been adjusted.

The sound was not working before either, and that has been corrected.

The next update will include fixes to bodily functions, more audio and some things to help pass the time at night, along with more fixes to bugs.

notes.title: New updates and issues addressed
notes.notes:
A few major issues have been addressed in the first couple updates I've pushed. The biggest improvement is to the framerate, which was in terrible shape. I saw some people getting around 30fps, and that's just unacceptable. So I brought in my pal Owen the Stophammer to help clean up what I couldn't manage. He's going to help make sure all my coding madness is running efficiently so you all get a better game. 

I also noticed some people were talking about suddenly being sent back to the main menu. This was happening because they were dying. There are two big issues here. First of all people are dying too fast and they don't have time figure the game out. Second, there is no screen or indicator showing people they are dying other than the notepad that shows stats. This will have to be dealt with right away, so I am going to adjust all the stats and make a death screen. It's ridiculous I didn't have that in there already.

Everyone seemed to figure out how to move, but if you're having issues movement is achieved by using the grips on the Vive controller and moving your arms back and forth. This will all be adjusted and possibly even changed completely in the future based on what people think of it. I like the idea myself, but if it's causing too many problems for people I may want to find another way.

There have been a few other quick fixes to the world, but there will be much more fixed up very soon. The next update will fix the food items that are currently in the game and add some more interactivity to the night and jail environments. I'll be sure there's some indicator that you're being sent to jail too.
